header.title: Applications & building the roommate group
header.subtitle: A simulation inspired by the Sarintany'COLOC journey to track applications, organize teams, and validate the roommate group.

realPanel.title: Applications received
realPanel.notApplied: You haven't applied for this listing yet.
realPanel.notAppliedHint: Apply by clicking the "Apply for this roommate group" button above.
realPanel.alreadyApplied: You've already applied for this listing.
realPanel.alreadyAppliedHint: Click "View my application" to see all applications.
realPanel.empty: No applications yet. Be the first to apply!

modals.applyIntro: Send a personalized message to boost your chances of being accepted.
modals.applyPlaceholder: Briefly introduce yourself and explain why you're interested...
modals.celebrationText: You've helped several roommates meet through your listing for a better shared living experience.

contract.title: Your roommate agreement
contract.intro: Your agreement includes everything needed to establish a legal contract between the roommates and the landlord.
contract.splitFee: The flat fee will be split between roommates — each pays their share. You (the owner) pay nothing.
contract.operatorFees: Operator fees are the buyer's responsibility.
contract.paidPart: Your share {{reference}} of {{amount}} Ar has been saved.
contract.allPaid: All shares are paid: the contract is validated.
contract.paymentCheck: The payment will be verified by our team.
contract.finalSave: By clicking Finish, the contract will be saved. Each roommate will then pay their share; you pay nothing.

notifications.title: Notification
notifications.noneWon: The accepted-roommate notification will be available once the roommate group is officially launched.
notifications.noneLost: The not-selected notification will be available once the roommate group is officially launched.
notifications.groupChatOpen: Your group chat stays open so you can organize.
notifications.backToMap: Back to the roommate group map
notifications.mapHint: Come back to the map to find a place that fits you even better.
notifications.alertHint: Turn on an alert to be notified of new roommate groups matching your criteria.

empty.candidatures: No applications yet. Be the first to apply!
empty.equipes: No teams yet. Be the first to create one!

track.modeDesc: Applicants form teams. The first complete team wins, but you decide whether to validate the complete team or wait a bit longer.
track.attributedDesc: Team {{team}} has been validated. The roommate group can start.
track.deadlineDesc: Max 3 days. Without your validation, the assignment becomes automatic.
track.roleDesc: You don't choose who joins which team: applicants organize themselves. Your role is to validate the complete team — or wait for the deadline, after which assignment becomes automatic.

cand.deleteTeamConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this team?
cand.leaveTeamConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this team?
cand.yourContractDesc: Your share of the Coloc'KOO fee for drawing up the agreement.
